outcome: frequency of SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnant women during childbirth
epidemiological characteristics of infected pregnant women
symptoms developed by newborns of infected mothers
cohort: 43 newborn infants born to mothers who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 24 hours prior to delivery or had been diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 prior to delivery and 3237 mothers giving birth
finding: This 21-month study found that infants born to mothers who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 did not experience worse prenatal and postnatal outcomes compared to infants of mothers who did not test positive for SARS-CoV-2.
mod_finding: All infants were breastfeeding after being discharged from the hospital.
